 Versus

 Appearance:
Shri Lal Gyanendra Singh Baghel - Advocate.

Order 
This is the fourth application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of temporary bail on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 02.06.2023 in connection with Crime No. 271/2023, registered at Police Station-Jiyawan District Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1), 376(2)(i), 450, 342 of IPC.
2. Applicant has filed application for grant of temporary bail on ground that applicant want to attend funeral rites and rituals of death of his son.
In these circumstances, it is prayed that applicant may be granted temporary bail for a period of 10 days.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State submitted that son of applicant has died in a road accident.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
In view of aforesaid verification, temporary bail application filed by the applicant is allowed for a period of 10 days.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on temporary bail for a period of 10 days from today (i.e. 2 MCRC-29750-2024 from 12.07.2024 to 22.07.2024) on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
6. Applicant will surrender on 23 rd July, 2024 before the trial Court to be sent to jail.
